en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional. 'А дадеја' I read as 'was given (in marriage)', my reading; 'ем говори' is a filler ('and speaks').

lines.en: Ah, Jana was given far away,
very far away, across two or three forests,

lines.cyr: преку две-три гори и четири реки.
lines.lat: preku dve-tri gori i četiri reki.
lines.en: across two or three forests and four rivers.

lines.cyr: Три години Јана откак' е мажена,
lines.lat: Tri godini Jana otkak' e mažena,
lines.en: It is three years since Jana was married,

lines.cyr: дума не продума, ни се насмејала.
lines.lat: duma ne produma, ni se nasmejala.
lines.en: she has not said a word, nor smiled.

lines.cyr: - Снаи, мили снаи, девет мили снаи,
lines.lat: - Snai, mili snai, devet mili snai,
lines.en: - Daughters-in-law, dear daughters-in-law, nine dear daughters-in-law,
dress Jana in a white dress

lines.cyr: и ја прошетајте в' новата градина.
lines.lat: i ja prošetajte v' novata gradina.
lines.en: and take her for a walk in the new garden.
In the apple tree a sad cuckoo calls,
then Jana speaks, she said a word:

lines.cyr: - Кукај кукавице, и ти како мене,
lines.lat: - Kukaj kukavice, i ti kako mene,
lines.en: - Call, cuckoo, you too like me,

lines.cyr: и ти како мене, без мајка и татко,
lines.lat: i ti kako mene, bez majka i tatko,
lines.en: you too like me, without mother and father,

lines.cyr: без мајка и татко, без браќа и сестри.
lines.lat: bez majka i tatko, bez braḱa i sestri.
lines.en: without mother and father, without brothers and sisters.
